items.summary: AZ wilde deze transferwindow de spelerskern intact houden en de selectie verbreden, om eindelijk af te rekenen met de wisselvalligheid van de laatste jaren. Technisch directeur Niels van Duinen maakt de balans op van zijn eerste transferzomer als technisch directeur in Alkmaar.

items.title: 'Ajax-opponent Hajduk Split haalt 32-voudig Rode Duivel naar Kroatië'
items.summary: Leander Dendoncker is binnenkort te aanschouwen op de Kroatische velden. De Belgische middenvelder heeft een contract getekend bij Hajduk Split, zo verzekeren media uit Kroatië. In oktober wacht Dendoncker derhalve een wedstrijd tegen Ajax.

items.title: Bayern komt vroege wereldgoal Osnabrück te boven en bekert verder
items.summary: Bayern München heeft de eerste ronde van de DFB-Pokal tegen VfL Osnabrück overleefd. Bij het basisdebuut van Ismael Saibari liet de club uit de Tweede Bundesliga Der Rekordmeister nog schrikken, maar uiteindelijk won Bayern eenvoudig (1-4).

items.title: Argentinië eert Messi: álle wedstrijden worden stilgelegd
items.summary: Lionel Messi krijgt tijdens de volgende speelronde van het Argentijnse voetbal een bijzonder eerbetoon. De Argentijnse voetbalbond (AFA) heeft besloten wedstrijden in alle mannen- en vrouwencategorieën tijdelijk stil te leggen om de loopbaan van de 39-jarige superster bij de nationale ploeg te vieren.

items.title: Walsh caps Champions League progress for Chelsea despite Real Sociedad grind
items.summary: Real Sociedad 0-1 Chelsea (agg 2-6) Keira Walsh scores at corner to settle tie Chelsea ensured there will be three Women’s Super League teams in the league phase of the Champions League as Keira Walsh’s second-half strike against Real Sociedad extended their three-goal margin from the first leg of the third-round qualifier. The 5-2 win against the Spanish side in Chelsea’s first game at Wimbledon’s Cherry Red Records stadium gave Sonia Bompastor’s side a commanding lead in the tie, after a rusty start had forced them to come from a goal down. It wasn’t a particularly pretty performance, though, and that continued into the second leg against La Real, who will now drop into the Europa League. Continue reading...

items.title: ‘A commodity’: Ismaïla Sarr’s agent wants respect for African players in transfer deals
items.summary: Diomansy Kamara says players must ‘be heard’ Monaco defend halting Lamine Camara’s Chelsea move Ismaïla Sarr’s agent has claimed some African players are treated like “a commodity” after Crystal Palace turned down Liverpool’s approach for the Senegal forward and Lamine Camara’s move from Monaco to Chelsea broke down on deadline day. Palace are understood to have rejected a bid from Liverpool for Sarr last week and insisted last season’s top scorer was not for sale. The 28-year-old, who missed the opening two matches against Everton and Manchester City after the manager, Pierre Sage, said he had picked up an injury, subsequently deleted all references to the Conference League winners from his social media accounts and is thought to have been disappointed by Palace’s stance. Continue reading...

items.title: Premier League money has lost all meaning amid chaotic spectacle of excess | Barney Ronay
items.summary: The transfer window has broken all rational rules and limits, leaving us to marvel and, ultimately, pick up the bill There was a research study a few years back into a key period in the life of the TV show Location, Location, Location. You know the one. Half an hour of mid-morning drift. Hosted by two people whose common quality is they both look as if the minced essence of Wellington boots, the Volvo XC40 and the phrase “picky bits” has been reconstituted into human shapes, then sent out to judge people for buying houses. The big reveal was always the bit where they came back a year later and saw how much the value had shifted. Because all conversations about houses are, in the end, an excuse to talk about money. Oh wow, it’s gone up by £20,000. You are good. Oh no, you’re now bankrupt and your flat looks like a hostage cell with fairy lights. Unlucky. You are bad. Continue reading...

items.title: Balogun pulled out of Everton move over handling of his medical, claim Monaco
items.summary: Thiago Scuro suggests Merseyside club responsible Monaco chief executive defends keeping Camara Folarin Balogun pulled out of a £40m move to Everton because of how he was treated over his medical, according to Monaco’s chief executive, Thiago Scuro, who also defended the late decision not to sell Lamine Camara to Chelsea. Balogun signed a deal sheet shortly before 11pm on deadline day to allow Everton to complete his transfer only to reject the move shortly after. Everton had renegotiated the structure of the fee with Monaco after discovering an issue with the US international’s medical and failing in attempts to sign Joshua Zirkzee or Tammy Abraham on loan. Continue reading...

items.title: Richarlison could still leave Tottenham as Trabzonspor weigh up bid for striker
items.summary: Turkish transfer window closes on Friday night Brazilian refused a return to Everton on Tuesday Richarlison is the subject of firm interest from Trabzonspor and could move there from Tottenham before the closure of the transfer window in Turkey on Friday night. The striker has asked to leave, according to the Spurs manager, Roberto De Zerbi, who did not stand in the way of two of his other players who did so before the deadline in England on Tuesday night: Kevin Danso and Pape Sarr. They were allowed to join Sunderland and Juventus respectively on loans with purchase clauses. Continue reading...

items.title: Leander Dendoncker a retrouvé un club et croisera Saint-Trond en Conference League
items.summary: Passé par le Sporting d'Anderlecht, Aston Villa ou encore le Napoli, l'ancien Diable Rouge Leander Dendoncker (32 sélections) était libre de tout contrat depuis son départ du Real Oviedo le 1er juillet. Le médian défensif aurait cependant trouvé un nouveau défi en Croatie, où il serait sur le point de s'engager avec le Hajduk Split, vice-champion en titre, qui disputera la phase de ligue de la Conference League et qui y croisera Saint-Trond.
